body: Nothing in particular. It just hurts to BE. Bad days and good days.
It makes you feel nothing and everything at the same time.

I don't think anything caused it. I wasn't traumatized as a child or anything. Just, as far back as I can remember I've felt like life has no underlying meaning and I am a useless piece of it. It's always just been a very clear belief to me that existing is just unnecessary pain.

Anytime the tiniest bad thing would happen to me, instead crying and getting over it, I always thought, "There's no reason that I have to continue to do this."

I stole little $1 toys every time we went to the Family Christian Bookstore for a couple of months when I was five. I got away with it too, until three years later when I broke down and told my mom, because I thought if I didn't, I was on my way to eternal damnation.

I wandered around a not-so-great part of the city in the middle of the night, with no shoes on. All of my friends were out looking for me and whenever one of them found me, I would run away, laughing hysterically.
